message: The argument of 'ConfigureAwait' after 'meta.ProceedAsync()' must be the literal 'true' or 'false', but it is '{0}'. To choose the value at compile time, use a compile-time 'if' statement with a literal argument in each branch.
title: The argument of ConfigureAwait after ProceedAsync must be a literal.
rationale: Language defects: the message uses the contraction 'can't' and a comma splice, and the title lacks an article ('has to have literal argument') and should use 'must'. The message also gives no way forward although the report site (TemplateCompilerRewriter.CompileTimeOnlyRewriter.TryRewriteProceedInvocation) rejects any non-literal, including compile-time aspect properties, which can be handled with a compile-time 'if' statement.
